Start with import — never output the word typescript on its own line. Chain .accepts({...}) and .returns({...}) before .run() when the request defines run input or workflow output. Wire accepts keys with ref("key"), not ref("step.output"). RETURNS property types must match .as values — model *.generate stores an object with text, so type returns as object (never string); chain nested fields with ref("prior.text"). Every step must use a real capability id from the environment summary. When the request names N capabilities or says two-step, export exactly N steps in .run([...]). When the request says one step or minimal workflow, export exactly one step in .run([...]). Chain steps with ref("priorStep.output") when passing outputs. No EQL or JSON-only workflow blobs.

    step("@executioncontrolprotocol/test.echo", "Echo").id("echo").with({ value: "hello" }).as("echo"),
    step("@executioncontrolprotocol/test.summarize", "Summarize")

      .with({ payload: ref("echo.output") })
      .as("summary"),
